name: Ghar.tv brand + person profile section spec
description: Single source of truth for every section a brand or person profile page can render. Every section here maps to a chassis class in dist/styles.min.css and to a data contract the backend fills. Programmers building the profile composer treat each section id as a stable contract — the output HTML, canonical CSS classes, variants, fields, and content-availability rules must not drift. Companion doc for article body blocks: EDITOR-blocks-spec.json. Companion for composition rules per category: COMPOSITION-RULES.md. Companion for entity relationships that feed content: ENTITY-RELATIONSHIPS.md. Companion for entitlement gates: ENTITLEMENTS.md.

globalRules.sectionWrap: max-width: var(--max-w) [1600px]; margin: 0 auto; padding: var(--pad-v) var(--pad-h)
globalRules.themeTokenSource: Set on <main> from tenant record. Every downstream accent, hover, contact-panel fill reads these two variables. Never hardcode brand hex.
globalRules.autoHideRule: Every section that can be absent ships with a `hidden` attribute + CSS rule that collapses it when the backend has no data. Never delete the section node. The section IS the DOM contract; the `hidden` state is what varies.
globalRules.sectionOrderRule: Composed per category from COMPOSITION-RULES.md. Admin can override display_order via profile_section_configs.
globalRules.contentAttributionRule: Content about a brand → brand profile. Content by/about a person → person profile. Never cross-contaminate. See PROFILE-TEMPLATES-HANDOFF.md §5.
globalRules.portraitDiscipline: Never a stock face, AI-generated face, or generic avatar. Real photograph of the named person OR typographic monogram (initials). Monogram is the majority case, not the fallback. See BRIEF-people-pages.md §4.
globalRules.personUniversalityRule: One template serves every person, across roughly twenty professions. Category shapes which SECTIONS are eligible + which VARIANT per section — NOT whether the page is themed. No per-tenant colour theming on persons.
globalRules.sponsoredContentRule: No section-level sponsorship. Per-card only. See feedback_no_section_level_sponsorship in memory.

chromeElements.description: Not sections in the composition-rules sense. Always present on every profile page. Not gate-able by category or entitlement.

microft.note: single-line Ghar.tv credit — NOT the portal footer

footer.note: person profiles ship the portal footer; brand profiles ship the micro-footer

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: The name-and-face moment. Every profile has one. Variants differ significantly by category and by whether the tenant has strong photography.

classic.label: Classic hero — full-bleed image + scrim + white text
classic.when_to_use: Legacy default. Currently: obeetee, saint-gobain, asian-paints. Pattern B port pending on these 3 per HANDOFF-INDEX.md §Pending big items.

split.label: Pattern B split hero — image band + white card lift + logo overlap
split.when_to_use: Preferred default for new tenants. Currently: teearch, avirahi, godrej, scarlet, horizon.
split.mobile_behaviour: Full-width image band → white rounded card lifts up via margin-top:-28px → logo tile straddles seam via absolute positioning

ambient.label: Ambient hero — warm SVG/graphic instead of photo
ambient.when_to_use: When brand doesn't have hero-quality photography OR when brand identity is graphical. Currently: horizon (warm SVG).

film.label: Film hero — commissioned video replaces hero image
film.when_to_use: Only tenants with commissioned Ghar.tv film. Currently: godrej.

portrait_first.label: Portrait-first hero — large portrait on right, name+role on left
portrait_first.when_to_use: When person has a real portrait. Default for architects + brand-leadership.

monogram.label: Monogram hero — typographic initials tile in place of portrait
monogram.when_to_use: When person has NO real portrait. THE MAJORITY CASE (22 of 31 people, per BRIEF-people-pages.md §4). Not a degraded fallback.

classic.label: Classic hero — name+role centred, portrait or monogram above
classic.when_to_use: Advisors + research + analysts — where the person's face isn't the story, the work is.

fields.notes: White or dark bg per contrast rule — see feedback_brand_logo_background_contrast in memory
Monogram fallback — always required even when portrait exists
Person's current primary brand — renders as "Partner, TEEARCH →" with brand name as link

content_availability_rules.brand_no_hero_image_no_ambient_no_film: Fall back to strongest available media OR clean minimal card with logo + name + tagline.
content_availability_rules.brand_no_logo: Never happens — logo is required for brands.
content_availability_rules.person_no_portrait: Force `monogram` variant. Never render a person hero with a missing image.

fallbacks.missing_photography: Use ambient variant if entitlement permits; otherwise show minimal classic with logo/monogram + name + eyebrow only.

about.name: About / Story
about.description: The lede + paragraphs section. On brand it's the practice/company description; on person it's the manifesto + biography. The load-bearing narrative section.

default.label: Default — lede + paragraphs + optional inline team + specialises

seamless.label: Seamless — About wraps into next section without hard boundary
seamless.when_to_use: When About flows naturally into Work (Teearch pattern).

editorial.label: Editorial — magazine-style long-read About with pull-quotes
editorial.when_to_use: Architecture practices with a design manifesto worth reading (Horizon-tier).

manifesto.label: Manifesto — display-scale lede + bio paragraphs unfold beneath
manifesto.when_to_use: When person has a real bio. Default for architects + brand-leadership.

statement.label: Statement — single 12-word claim by Ghar.tv, no bio
statement.when_to_use: When we have no verified biography. NEVER attribute the statement to the person — it's Ghar.tv's description of them, never words in their mouth. See BRIEF-people-pages.md §8.

none.label: No about section
none.when_to_use: Sparse record. Section does not render.

fields.notes: 12-word maximum. Ghar.tv-authored description of the person.
Read-more script wraps paragraphs > threshold into .bpr-about__body-inner

specialises.name: Specialisations
specialises.description: Up to five named competences (e.g. 'Redevelopment', 'Feasibility & TDR advisory'). Warm-cream panel or chip list.

warm_panel.label: Warm-cream panel with heading + chip grid
warm_panel.when_to_use: Default. Reads as an intentional block.

facts.name: Facts / Figures
facts.description: 2–4 real numbers with labels. Never derived, never rounded up. Never fabricated.

meta_row.label: Inline meta-row inside hero — icons + label + value

strip.label: Fact strip — horizontal row of {label, value} pairs

bordered_grid.label: Bordered grid — 2-col grid with hairline dividers between cells
bordered_grid.when_to_use: Mobile only. Last cell spans both columns when odd. See PROFILE-TEMPLATES-HANDOFF.md §11.

content_availability_rules.empty: Hide section (brand meta-row collapses; person facts strip hides).

editorial_rules.no_fabrication: Every number must be verifiable. If we can't source it, we don't render it.
editorial_rules.indian_conventions: ₹, lakhs and crores, DD/MM dates — not $, thousands, MM/DD.

work.name: Notable projects / Work
work.description: The entity's projects. On a brand page: full portfolio (or curated set + link to more). On a person page: a 4-item teaser + link to the brand's full portfolio (never duplicates the brand's project list).

spotlight.label: Featured project spotlight — one hero project drives everything below
spotlight.when_to_use: 1 headline project OR admin picks one to hero.

grid.label: Project grid — 3–8 delivered projects, no single hero

carousel.label: Project carousel — 9+ projects, rail + paginator + See all link

editorial.label: Editorial set — projects with editorial context per card
editorial.when_to_use: Architecture practices where each project has a story.

teaser.label: Person-page teaser — 4-item indexed list + link out to brand's full portfolio
teaser.when_to_use: Default. Person profile never duplicates the brand's project list. See PROFILE-TEMPLATES-HANDOFF.md §6.

grid_bare.label: Bare grid — for people without a linked brand

fields.example: Delivered with TEEARCH. See the full portfolio on TEEARCH.

content_availability_rules.single_item: Force `spotlight` variant regardless of other config.
content_availability_rules.two_items: Choose `spotlight` if featured_id set, otherwise compact grid.

fallbacks.no_project_photography: Use typed Gazpacho card composed from project city + type.
fallbacks.brand_no_projects_but_intelligence_exist: Suppress this section; Intelligence section carries the brand's authority instead.
fallbacks.person_no_projects: Suppress. Person profile does not force-show an empty Work section.

recognition.name: Recognition / Awards
recognition.description: Awards, honours, appointments. Awarding body and year. Both optional per item.

strip.label: Compact strip — attached to prior section, hairline separators
strip.when_to_use: Default for developer family (attached to About). Currently: godrej, avirahi.

list.label: Full list — standalone section with heading
list.when_to_use: When brand has 6+ awards / a serious body of recognition.

list.label: Ordered list — award name, awarding body, year
list.when_to_use: Default when present. Most people have no awards — hide when empty.

none.label: No recognition section
none.when_to_use: Ordinary case. Most people in a directory have never been given an award.

content_availability_rules.empty: Hide section — do NOT show a placeholder "no awards yet" note.

team.name: Team / Leadership / People
team.description: Named humans associated with the entity. On brand: the leadership / partners / founders. On person: co-workers ("Also at {brand}"). Photos or monograms per feedback_no_person_without_portrait rule.

grid.label: Team grid — 3+ leaders in a responsive grid

leadership.label: Leadership spotlight — 2–4 spotlit partners with role + short bio

founder.label: Founder spotlight — 1 spotlit founder
founder.when_to_use: Founder-led brands where one identity carries the practice.

co_workers.label: Co-worker cards — 2–3 people at the same current brand
co_workers.when_to_use: Default when person has a primary brand relationship.

similar_discipline.label: Similar-discipline cards — for people without a linked brand

content_availability_rules.no_people_with_real_portraits_and_no_mon: Hide section. Per feedback_no_person_without_portrait — hide the card, wire the class into every count.

fallbacks.person_no_portrait_has_initials: Render as Gazpacho monogram tile. See feedback_team_photos_real_only.

timeline.name: Timeline / History
timeline.description: Company milestones. Vertical or horizontal. Optional on all brands; primarily used by developer family with long history (Godrej 1897).

vertical.label: Vertical timeline — year + event pairs stacked

horizontal.label: Horizontal timeline — scrollable era strip
horizontal.when_to_use: Brands with 5+ major milestones spanning eras.

content_availability_rules.less_than_3_items: Hide section — timeline needs enough data to feel intentional.

presence.name: Presence / Locations
presence.description: Where the brand operates — cities, offices, markets.

list.label: City list — comma-separated or hairline-separated cities

map.label: Static map — India map with pins per city

city_cards.label: City cards — one card per city with address / phone
city_cards.when_to_use: Brands with a small number of prominent locations.

spotlight.name: Spotlight — editorial + intelligence + voices callouts
spotlight.description: Mixed callout section surfacing Ghar.tv's own coverage of the brand: editorial articles, intelligence reports, voices. Warm-white ground per feedback_warm_white_canvas_validated.

mixed.label: Mixed — editorial + intelligence + voices in one section
mixed.when_to_use: Default for service family. Currently: teearch, horizon, scarlet.

editorial_only.label: Editorial-only — articles about the brand
editorial_only.when_to_use: Brand has articles but no intel/voices coverage yet.

intelligence_only.label: Intelligence-only — reports + research
intelligence_only.when_to_use: Brand has research coverage but no editorial.

voices_only.label: Voices-only — person-attributed quotes about the brand
voices_only.when_to_use: Rare — typically when a partner brand's founder has widely-quoted commentary.

intelligence.name: Intelligence — reports + research + rankings
intelligence.description: Dedicated intelligence surface (as opposed to intel-inside-spotlight). Title-as-visual pattern per project_intelligence_titlecard_pattern.

title_card.label: Title cards — no image, big Gazpacho title, warm-neutral rotating tones
title_card.when_to_use: Default. Warm-neutral rotation (sand / sage / mist / blush / ivory / clay). No brand-red on cards.

report_list.label: Report list — hairline-separated list of reports
report_list.when_to_use: Compact treatment for brands with 10+ reports.

content_availability_rules.empty: Hide section — do not render empty state.

voices.name: Voices
voices.description: Person-attributed quotes with source receipts. .vx-card is claim first, then hairline, then speaker credit. NO image on card face per VOICES-HANDOFF.md §7.

rail.label: Full rail with paginator + "All voices" CTA
rail.when_to_use: Brands with 6+ voices from associated people.
rail.note: Currently unused on live tenants — Avirahi's Voices row was removed per attribution rule. Reserved for future use.

native_rail.label: Native horizontal scroll rail
native_rail.when_to_use: Automatic on ≤ 899px viewports — flex + overflow-x + scroll-snap + viewport-edge bleed.

content_availability_rules.brand_voices_are_person_attributed_by_de: Voices belong on person profiles by default. On brand, only surface voices that specifically NAME the brand as subject.
content_availability_rules.person_only_one_voice: Still render — single card is legitimate for a person.

editorial_rules.editorial_framing_required: .vx-quote__why is never optional — explains why the quote matters.
editorial_rules.source_receipt_required: .vx-source with platform + date + live outbound link.

published.name: Published coverage — On Ghar.tv
published.description: Ghar.tv's own pieces BY or ABOUT the person. Features, interviews, podcast episodes, op-eds, research reports.

multi_kind.label: Mixed article / podcast / research grid
multi_kind.when_to_use: Person has coverage of multiple content types.

single_kind.label: Single-kind list — e.g. all interviews
single_kind.when_to_use: Person has coverage of one type only.

empty_note.label: Empty-state note — warm-cream panel pointing to related content
empty_note.when_to_use: Person has NO published coverage — but the empty state carries editorial framing.

fields.resolver: content_resolver.articles_by + articles_about + ghartalks + intelligence (attribution rule ENFORCED)

content_availability_rules.empty_and_no_associated_brand_content: Render `empty_note` OR hide entirely per admin config.

editorial_rules.attribution_enforced: Person profile shows only content BY or ABOUT the person. Never JOIN to employer's brand-attributed articles unless article specifically names the person. See PROFILE-TEMPLATES-HANDOFF.md §5.

credentials.name: Credentials / Registrations
credentials.description: Formal registrations as label-and-value pairs. e.g. 'Registration · Council of Architecture (COA)'.

same_project_brands.label: Brands that worked on the same projects

co_workers.label: Also at {brand} — 2–3 co-workers at current primary brand

similar_discipline.label: Similar architects in {city} — for people without a linked brand

products.name: Products / Collections
products.description: For product brands — materials, furniture, lighting, sanitaryware. Not for developers or architects.

catalog.label: Product catalog — category-grouped grid
catalog.when_to_use: Default for materials + lighting brands with wide catalog.

collection.label: Collection showcase — curated collections as spotlights

featured.label: Featured product — one hero product with detail
featured.when_to_use: Brands leading with a signature product.

clients.name: Clients
clients.description: For service brands — who the brand has worked for. Logo wall or category grid.

logo_wall.label: Logo wall — client logos in a grid

category_grid.label: Grouped by client category — developers / retail / hospitality
category_grid.when_to_use: Brands with clients across distinct sectors.

editorial_rules.clients_belong_to_brand: A firm's clients belong to the firm's page, not to an individual's. Do not surface a brand's clients on a person page.

film.name: Commissioned film
film.description: Ghar.tv-commissioned brand film — VideoWorks output. Premium capability.

inline.label: Inline film section — YouTube facade + play overlay

hero_replacement.label: Film replaces the hero image
hero_replacement.when_to_use: Brand chose film as its identity moment.
hero_replacement.note: Overlaps with hero.film variant — use ONE of the two, not both.

contact.name: Contact
contact.description: Contact CTA that opens the shared brContact modal. NOT an inline form (form was replaced with a button in the uncommitted stretch — the modal is the canonical enquiry surface).

light.label: Light warm-cream panel with dark text + brand accent bar

dark.label: Dark panel — moody treatment
dark.when_to_use: Opt-in variant for tenants wanting the moody treatment. Currently: godrej + 3 older tenants (obeetee, saint-gobain, asian-paints — migration to light pending).

button.label: Contact button — opens shared modal, aligns to .pp-wrap grid
button.when_to_use: Default after form-to-button batch. See uncommitted-stretch changes.

contact.shared_wiring: brContactOpen(name) / brContactClose() / brContactSubmit(e) — currently inline per page; extract to dist/br-contact.js pending

closer.name: Closer / Final CTA
closer.description: Warm-cream panel with Gazpacho title, primary CTA + subtle secondary link. Not a duplicate of the contact section — this is a designed punctuation moment.

default.label: Standard closer
default.structure: h2 title + lede + primary button + secondary text link

modifiers.description: Modifier classes that stack on any section. Not primary variants; cross-cutting attributes.

--tight.when_to_use: When a section belongs visually close to its neighbours (e.g. presence + timeline stacked).

--attached.effect: Removes top boundary; visually links to prior section
--attached.when_to_use: Currently: recognition attached to about on developer family.

--minor.effect: De-prioritised visual weight — smaller title, tighter spacing
--minor.when_to_use: Currently: team on person profiles (co-worker cards under contact).

--dark.effect: Dark panel treatment — inverts colours for section
--dark.when_to_use: Opt-in dark treatment for contact panel on selected tenants.

--seamless-wrap.effect: Removes section boundary; flows into next section

steps: 1. Load entity + relationships via content resolver.
5. For each section in Section Registry:
a. Skip if composition rule excludes it for this category.
b. Skip if entitlement gate not passed.
c. Load content for section via resolver.
d. If content empty, apply fallback OR hide.
e. Pick variant: config override → composition rule default → content-availability rule default.
f. Render section HTML (chassis + variant + modifier stack).
6. Apply motion profile (MOTION-SYSTEM.md) at page + section level.
renderContract.idempotent: Running the composer twice on (entity_id, config, viewer) produces the same output. Required for caching + A/B test integrity.

validationOnSave: Every section marked `required` for a category MUST have data OR admin must explicitly hide it.
Every section with `requires_entitlement` MUST have the entitlement OR the section is silently skipped.
Every section's `variant` MUST exist in the section's `brand_variants` or `person_variants` map.
Every section's `content_source` in profile_section_configs MUST be one of: auto, manual_select, manual_content, custom_html.
Motion profile MUST be one of: minimal, editorial, cinematic, dynamic.
Brand theme tokens (--brand, --brand-soft) MUST be valid hex.
Person profile MUST NOT have theme tokens set (universality rule).
